title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
overview: The Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) course is designed for individuals who are new to cloud computing and Microsoft Azure. This course provides foundational knowledge of Azure services, cloud concepts, and Azure management tools, preparing participants for the Azure Fundamentals certification exam.
audience: Individuals new to cloud computing and Microsoft Azure.
Non-technical professionals such as sales, marketing, and business professionals who interact with Azure.
IT professionals and students seeking a foundational understanding of Azure services.
Anyone preparing for the Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of Azure services, cloud concepts, and management tools.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for interacting with Azure services and tools.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to understand Azure solutions and use cases.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore Azure concepts and applications.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Tools to assess knowledge and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of cloud computing and Microsoft Azure.
To prepare participants for the Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) exam.
To familiarize learners with Azure services, pricing, and management tools.
To introduce basic concepts of Azure security, compliance, and governance.

items.text: Overview of Cloud Computing
Cloud Service Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
Cloud Deployment Models (Public, Private, Hybrid)
Benefits of Cloud Computing
Introduction to Azure and Its Core Services
Azure Compute Services (Virtual Machines, App Services, Azure Functions)
Azure Storage Services (Blob Storage, Disk Storage, File Storage)
Azure Networking Services (Virtual Networks, VPN, Azure CDN)
Azure Pricing and Cost Management
Understanding Azure Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
Azure Pricing Calculator and Cost Management Tools
Azure Service Lifecycle and Updates
Azure Governance Tools (Azure Policy, Blueprints)
Understanding Azure Compliance Offerings
Data Privacy and Security in Azure
Regulatory and Compliance Standards (GDPR, HIPAA)
Azure Security Fundamentals and Best Practices
Identity and Access Management (IAM) in Azure
Azure Security Center and Azure Key Vault
Implementing Basic Security Measures (Network Security Groups, Firewall)
Overview of Azure Management Tools (Azure Portal, Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell)
Monitoring and Reporting with Azure Monitor
Resource Management with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) Templates
Managing and Configuring Azure Resources
